saints.name: St. Adelaide
saints.title: Empress
saints.shortBlurb: A queen imprisoned and delivered, empress of the Romans, who in widowhood gave herself to peace-making and the poor…
biography: Adelaide, born about 931, was daughter of the king of Burgundy and married young to the king of Italy. Widowed and then imprisoned by a usurper, she was rescued by Otto the Great of Germany, whom she married; she was crowned empress at Rome and became one of the most respected women of her age.

As mother and grandmother of emperors, and for a time regent, she used her influence for the peace of the realm, the reform of monasteries, and the relief of the poor. She retired at last near a convent she had founded and died in 999, honored as a saint.
saints.knownFor: Holy Roman Empress and benefactress of the Church.

canonization.canonized: Canonized in 1097 by Pope Urban II

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 16 December
